verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's first-party docs state that by default, and to speed up requests, it blocks all images and CSS in the scraped page. The `block_resources=false` parameter turns this off when a developer needs those resources. block_ads is a separate, related option. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the default blocking and its bandwidth/speed benefit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can block images and CSS resources by default to reduce bandwidth and speed up requests

citations.quote: By default, and to speed up requests, ScrapingBee blocks all images and CSS in the scraped page, but to scrape them, use `block_resources=false`
